extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants, patent attorneys/agents, and patent examiners dealing with Japanese patent and utility model practice
extracted.subtask_description: Official Japan Patent Office Examination Guidelines covering substantive and procedural standards for patents and utility models (enablement, claims, novelty/inventive step, amendments, unity, priority, foreign-language filings, term extension, utility models, etc.). Intended to guide examination and prosecution in Japan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provisional translation / Japanese text precedence
rubrics_metrics.description: When any ambiguity of interpretation is found in this provisional translation, the Japanese text shall prevail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The English text is a provisional translation; consult the Japanese original when ambiguous.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicable periods and applications of these Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Specification of which versions of the Examination Guidelines apply to examinations and the effective dates (e.g., Guidelines effective on and after October 1, 2015; previous Guidelines remain effective for examinations on or before September 30, 2015).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidelines include revision history and special applicability rules (see linked page for product-by-process claims and patent term extension grandfathering).

rubrics_metrics.name: Principles of Examination and Flow of Examination
rubrics_metrics.description: High-level principles and procedural flow used by examiners for patent and utility model examinations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Chapter 1 (Principles of Examination and Flow of Examination) for procedural flowcharts and principles (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedures of Examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed procedures to be followed during examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Chapter 2 (Procedures of Examination) for sectioned procedures including specification of claimed invention, prior art search, notice of reasons for refusal, handling of written opinions/amendments, decisions, appeals, communications, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specifying Claimed Invention
rubrics_metrics.description: How to determine and specify what is claimed in an application for purposes of examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Section 1 of Chapter 2 for guidance on identifying the claimed technical scope (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior Art Search and Determination of Novelty, Inventive Step, etc.
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and procedures for conducting prior art searches and determining novelty and inventive step.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Section 2 of Chapter 2 and Part III for detailed rules and procedures (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of Reasons for Refusal
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and form of a Notice of Reasons for Refusal issued by examiners when an application is objectionable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Section 3 of Chapter 2 for standards on what must be communicated and how (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Handling of Written Opinion, Written Amendment, etc.
rubrics_metrics.description: How written opinions and written amendments by applicants are processed and assessed during examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Section 4 of Chapter 2 for procedures and examiner responses (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and procedures for making a final decision on patentability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Section 5 of Chapter 2 for decision criteria and process (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision of Dismissal of Amendment
rubrics_metrics.description: When and how an examiner may dismiss an amendment, and the standards governing such dismissals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Section 6 of Chapter 2 for grounds and procedures (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reconsideration by Examiners before Appeal Proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for internal reconsideration by examiners prior to an appeal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Section 7 of Chapter 2 for reconsideration steps and criteria (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Communication with Applicant and Request for Documents etc. Required for the Examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for communications between the Office and applicant and what documents/explanations may be requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Section 8 of Chapter 2 for acceptable requests and limits on communications (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Enablement Requirement (Patent Act Article 36(4)(i))
rubrics_metrics.description: Description must enable a person skilled in the art to carry out the invention as claimed (enablement requirement).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part II Chapter 1 Section 1 for examples, required level of detail, and how enablement is assessed (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Ministerial Ordinance Requirement (Description) (Patent Act Article 36(4)(i))
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional formal or content requirements for the description as prescribed by ministerial ordinance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part II Chapter 1 Section 2 for specifics of ministerial ordinances governing descriptions (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for Disclosure of Information on Prior Art Documents (Patent Act Article 36(4)(ii))
rubrics_metrics.description: Obligation to disclose information on relevant prior art documents in the description where applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part II Chapter 1 Section 3 for what must be disclosed and how to present prior art information (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent Act Article 36(5) (Requirements for Claims)
rubrics_metrics.description: General statutory provisions governing the claims (statement and form of claims).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part II Chapter 2 Section 1 for how Article 36(5) is applied in practice (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Support Requirement (Claims) (Patent Act Article 36(6)(i))
rubrics_metrics.description: Claims must be supported by the description — claims should not claim subject-matter beyond what is described.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part II Chapter 2 Section 2 for tests of support, examples, and anti-patterns (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarity Requirement (Claims) (Patent Act Article 36(6)(ii))
rubrics_metrics.description: Claims must be clear; ambiguous wording or indefinite terms that obscure the scope are objectionable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part II Chapter 2 Section 3 for examples of unclear claim language and how examiners evaluate clarity (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Conciseness Requirement (Claims) (Patent Act Article 36(6)(iii))
rubrics_metrics.description: Claims should be concise and not include unnecessary repetition or superfluous elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part II Chapter 2 Section 4 for guidance on claim drafting to meet conciseness requirements (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Ministerial Ordinance Requirement on Statement of Claims (Patent Act Article 36(6)(iv))
rubrics_metrics.description: Formal requirements for the statement/format of claims as prescribed by ministerial ordinance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part II Chapter 2 Section 5 for the specific ministerial ordinance requirements (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of Invention (Patent Act Article 37)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that claims in an application relate to a single general inventive concept (unity of invention).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part II Chapter 3 and additional reference 'Requirements for Unity of Application' for tests and examples (PDFs).

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility for Patent and Industrial Applicability (Article 29(1))
rubrics_metrics.description: Substantive eligibility — an invention must fall within patentable subject matter and be industrially applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part III Chapter 1 for interpretation of patentable categories and industrial applicability (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Novelty (Patent Act Article 29(1))
rubrics_metrics.description: An invention must be new compared to the prior art; standards and examples for assessing novelty.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part III Chapter 2 Section 1 for novelty tests, how to identify relevant disclosures, and examples (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventive Step (Patent Act Article 29(2))
rubrics_metrics.description: An invention must involve an inventive step (non-obviousness) over the prior art; standards and reasoning approaches.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part III Chapter 2 Section 2 for approaches to problem-solution analysis and evaluation of inventive step (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure of Determining Novelty and Inventive Step
rubrics_metrics.description: Step-by-step procedure for examiners to determine novelty and inventive step (how to structure the assessment).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part III Chapter 2 Section 3 for procedural methodology and examples (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims Including Specific Expressions
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for handling claims that include particular expressions or claim language that affects novelty/inventive step determinations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part III Chapter 2 Section 4 for treatment of numerical ranges, functional language, product-by-process expressions, etc. (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Exceptions to Lack of Novelty of Invention (Patent Act Article 30)
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances in which certain disclosures do not destroy novelty (statutory exceptions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part III Chapter 2 Section 5 for statutory exceptions (e.g., grace periods, disclosures under specific conditions) and examples (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Secret Prior Art (Patent Act Article 29bis)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for handling secret prior art (internal or secret uses/disclosures) that may affect patentability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part III Chapter 3 for definitions and examination practices regarding secret prior art (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior Application (Patent Act Article 39)
rubrics_metrics.description: Effects of earlier-filed but later-published/handled applications on novelty and entitlement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part III Chapter 4 for how prior applications are treated in examination (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Category of Unpatentable Invention (Patent Act Article 32)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific categories of subject-matter excluded from patent protection under Article 32.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part III Chapter 5 for enumerated unpatentable categories and examples (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for Amendments (Patent Act Article 17bis)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards governing permissible amendments to description, claims, or drawings during prosecution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part IV Chapter 1 for general amendment rules and examples (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment Adding New Matter (Patent Act Article 17bis(3))
rubrics_metrics.description: Prohibition/limits on amendments that would add subject-matter not originally disclosed (new matter).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part IV Chapter 2 for tests and examples of prohibited new matter and allowable corrections (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment Changing Special Technical Feature of Invention (Patent Act Article 17bis(4))
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules controlling amendments that change special technical features of the claimed invention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part IV Chapter 3 for when such amendments are permitted or refused and how to assess impact (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment for other than the Prescribed Purposes (Patent Act Article 17bis(5))
rubrics_metrics.description: Restrictions on amendments that are made for purposes other than those prescribed by statute (e.g., to broaden unjustifiably).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part IV Chapter 4 for examples and examiner practice (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority under the Paris Convention
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for claiming priority from an earlier application under the Paris Convention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part V Chapter 1 for time limits, required evidence, and formalities (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Internal Priority
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for claiming internal priority (priority between related filings within Japan).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part V Chapter 2 for conditions and required filings (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Division of Patent Application (Patent Act Article 44) — Requirements for Division
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for dividing an application into one or more divisional applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part VI Chapter 1 Section 1 for when division is permitted and formal requirements (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice under Article 50bis (Division Notices)
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural rules and notices related to division under Article 50bis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part VI Chapter 1 Section 2 for detailed procedures and examples (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Conversion of Application (Patent Act Article 46)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for converting applications (e.g., between patent and utility model filings) and the conditions required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part VI Chapter 2 for formalities and substantive effects (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent Application Based on Utility Model Registration (Patent Act Article 46bis)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for filing a patent application based on an existing utility model registration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part VI Chapter 3 for timing, required disclosures, and conversion mechanics (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference filing (Patent Act Article 38ter)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and use-cases for reference filings and their treatment in examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part VI Chapter 4 for practice guidance (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Overview of Foreign Language Written Application System
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview of rules allowing filings in foreign languages and the framework of the foreign-language written application system in Japan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part VII Chapter 1 for system scope, requirements, and applicant obligations (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of Foreign Language Written Application
rubrics_metrics.description: How foreign-language applications are examined, including required translations, timing, and special procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part VII Chapter 2 for procedural and substantive examination rules for foreign language filings (large PDF: detailed guidance).

rubrics_metrics.name: International Patent Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on handling international (PCT) patent applications entering or filed in Japan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part VIII for procedures, national phase entry requirements, and how PCT results are applied in Japanese examination (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Extension of a Patent Term as Compensation for Curtailment (Patent Act Article 67(2))
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and procedures for extending patent term to compensate for term curtailment (e.g., regulatory delays).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part IX Chapter 1 for eligibility, calculation, and filing requirements (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Extension of Patent Term for Pharmaceutical Inventions (Patent Act Article 67(4))
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific rules for patent term extension applicable to pharmaceutical inventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part IX Chapter 2 for special rules, required evidence, and calculation methods (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Basic Requirements for Utility Model Registration
rubrics_metrics.description: Substantive and formal requirements for registration of utility models (a distinct, usually less-stringent protection than patents).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part X Chapter 1 for conditions, technical requirements, and distinctions from patents (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Utility Model Technical Opinion
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure and standards for issuing a technical opinion on utility model registrations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part X Chapter 2 for how technical opinions are produced and used in utility model practice (PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Handling Procedures for Examinations involving Product-by-process Claims
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific procedures/guidance for examining claims that define products by the process by which they are made.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Separate linked page provides the text applicable to product-by-process claim examinations (see link on index page).
